reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to provide UI controls for configuring and monitoring Skills and MCP servers within DeepSeek Harness settings and sidebar panels, making it a navigation interface utility rather than a build, testing, or research tool. Evidence from README and package metadata consistently describes in-app management workflows and live runtime status display.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的技能与 MCP 管理插件，在设置页支持管理技能和 MCP 服务器，并在侧边栏展示 MCP 的实时连接状态与工具信息。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a DeepSeek Harness interface for managing skills and MCP servers in Settings, with a sidebar view that shows live MCP connection status and related runtime details.

capabilities: Manage DeepSeek Harness skills and MCP servers through UI settings
Display live MCP server connection status in a sidebar panel
Apply MCP enable/disable configuration changes without restart

reasons.code: README states the plugin manages skills and MCP servers in Settings and shows live MCP status in the sidebar
README describes per-server MCP status visibility, including connection state and tool count, with polling while visible
README notes MCP add/edit/remove and enable/disable operations are hot-applied through ctx.loader
package.json declares a web platform DSH client plugin with injected runtime/UI dependencies
Repository description names it as a Skill & MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness
